title: RepositorySnapshot
description: Atomic repository replacement scoped to one host-installed binding.

account.description: Account used for this read; absent for public unauthenticated access.

checked_at_ms.description: Epoch milliseconds of this snapshot attempt.

checkout.description: Read-only local checkout details, if available.

collaborators.description: Accessible GitHub collaborator entries, without Idle grants.

contributors.description: GitHub contribution history, distinct from collaboration access.

git_authors.description: Git authors within the read's declared bounds.

github.description: GitHub metadata, if the remote and current credentials support it.

reports.description: Source availability and explicit bounds, including known empty results.

scope.description: Exact scope requested by the client and installed by the host.

sessions.description: Local and imported recorded session items.

GitAuthor.description: A recorded Git author in the declared bounded commit history.

commits.description: Commits in this read, not a repository-wide total.

name.description: Author name recorded in commits, without identity merging.

GitCheckout.description: The selected checkout, read locally without fetching or changing Git state.

branch.description: Current branch; absent for a detached HEAD.

common_directory.description: Shared Git directory, when linked worktrees share objects and refs.

git_directory.description: Checkout-specific Git directory, distinct in linked worktrees.

head.description: Full commit ID; absent on an unborn branch.

remote.description: Sanitized remote location with user information and query removed.

remote_name.description: Chosen branch remote or `origin`, if configured.

status.description: Worktree counts, absent if the bounded status read failed.

GithubPerson.description: A GitHub account listed by a contributor or collaborator endpoint.

contributions.description: Supplied contribution count, distinct from live activity.

id.description: Stable numeric GitHub account identity represented as text.

role.description: GitHub repository role, never an Idle access grant.

GithubRepository.description: GitHub repository metadata; no Idle permissions are derived from it.

full_name.description: Canonical owner and repository name supplied by GitHub.

ReadReport.description: Scope, bounds and currentness of a single source read.

checked_at_ms.description: Epoch milliseconds when this read was attempted; not a durable cursor.

message.description: Human-readable scope, bound or failure reason.

retry_at_ms.description: Earliest retry supplied by the service, if known.

source_url.description: Public HTTPS source location without credentials.

topic.description: Stable source category such as `git.authors` or `github.issues`.

ReadState.description: Whether the named read covers its declared scope.

oneOf.description: All results within the stated query scope were read.
The read reached a limit or one part failed.
This repository has no applicable source for the read.

RecordedSession.description: A recorded session item, without inferring current execution or ordering.

actions.description: Recorded lifecycle observations, never a claim that a runtime is alive.

id.description: Full logical session identity used by the history filter.

labels.description: Distinct recorded labels; conflicting or changing titles remain visible.

records.description: Exact accepted session observations within this bounded read.

sources.description: Original provider names, or the direct recorder identity.

RepositoryScope.description: One explicit host-installed repository and logical chain.

repository_id.description: Host-installed repository identity, including checkout isolation.

SourceRecord.description: Full address of a single accepted stored representation.

record_hash.description: Full digest of the exact stored encoding.

WorktreeStatus.description: Changed paths counted from Git's porcelain output; rename pairs count once.

untracked.description: Untracked paths or directories according to Git's normal status mode.
